title: Vision Beat Himself With a Question
description: Why does Vision ask his enemy about a boat? The Ship of Theseus conversation in WandaVision turns a fight into a question of identity and memory. This recaps the 2021 finale only.
hook: In WandaVision's finale, Vision's own dead body comes back with orders to kill him.
payoff: White Vision recognizes himself and flies away. But Wanda's Vision is still a separate being, tied to the world she created.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: In WandaVision's finale, Vision's own dead body comes back with orders to kill him.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: But his target is Wanda's magical recreation. White Vision has the original body; his opponent has none of the original parts.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: They are equally matched, so Vision challenges the order itself: which one is the real target?
units.onscreen: WHO IS HE ORDERED TO DESTROY?
units.visual_query: WHO IS HE ORDERED TO DESTROY?

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: They compare it to a ship. Replace every rotten plank: is it still the original?

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Now rebuild a second ship from the old wood. Both have a claim. Neither is the unchanged original.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: They fit the same puzzle: the rebuilt body has lost access to its memories, while Wanda's creation has no original material.
units.onscreen: THE SHIP PROBLEM IS THEIR PROBLEM
units.visual_query: THE SHIP PROBLEM IS THEIR PROBLEM

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: But White Vision's data hasn't been erased. He lets his counterpart unlock it, and his past comes back.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: White Vision recognizes himself and flies away. But Wanda's Vision is still a separate being, tied to the world she created.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: So the original body survives, while the husband Wanda knows still has to say goodbye.
units.onscreen: A BODY SURVIVES. A GOODBYE REMAINS.
